title: Cost filter micro-interactions & rollout inspector — design review and stakeholder sign-off
creator: Ava Park
description: Polish and finalize micro-interactions for the cost filter UI and the rollout inspector preview so stakeholders can sign off. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, motion specs (duration/easing), accessibility states, and a developer-ready handoff package. The aim is to improve perceived performance and clarity for cost breakdowns (tokenized filter chips, hover affordances, inline tooltips) and to ensure the rollout inspector transitions are smooth and non-distracting during live rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype with annotated motion specs uploaded to Figma
Design tokens for durations/easings documented and mapped to frontend variables
Accessibility checks: keyboard focus states, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for interactive elements
Developer handoff doc (motion specs + SVG icons + exported assets) linked in the ticket
Stakeholder sign-off captured in comments from PM and ENG leads
qa_checklist: Verify chip expand/collapse animation runs at 120ms for fade + 160ms for slide as documented
Confirm tab-key navigation reaches all interactive items in filter panel and inspector
Validate tooltips appear on hover and on focus (for keyboard users) and dismiss on escape
Check visual regression against baseline screenshots on chrome/firefox/safari
Ensure no jank on low-end devices (simulate 3G CPU throttling)
decisions: Use 120ms ease-out for fade transitions, 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) for sliding chips
Tokenize cost filters as removable chips rather than dropdown rows to reduce click depth
Keep subtle scale on hover for chip affordance (+3%); avoid large motion that distracts from metrics
Rollout inspector will use layered crossfade + vertical slide to preserve context when switching variants
next_steps: Incorporate ENG feedback on anim perf (ENG-2210) and update motion tokens if necessary
Produce a flattened developer handoff PDF that includes CSS timing variables and exported svgs
Schedule 30-minute sign-off with PM (Jordan Liu) and Eng lead (Priya Kapoor) 2026-03-14
Ship a small A/B test for the new chip interactions behind a feature flag for 2 weeks post-release
